 Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
 Date : February 2, 2023.
P.C. :

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP.
2.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in respect of First Information Report (FIR) No.
0005/2023 registered on January 3, 2023 with Kasturba Marg Police Station, under Sections 328,
272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter "the IPC", for short) read with 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. On secret information received against the accused no.1, the contraband substances worth Rs.34,800/- were seized from the possession of the accused no.1.

During the Diksha Rane 905. ABA 323-23.doc course of the interrogation of the accused no.1, it was revealed that the applicant herein had supplied the alleged contraband substances to the accused no.1 to sell in Borivali and Mumbai.

sentences.text: The accused no.1 has been released on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was not named in the FIR.
There is one C.R. of similar nature which has been registered against the applicant.

The applicant has been granted bail in that C.R.
5.
Let the applicant attend the investigating officer on 4th, 5th and 6th February, 2023, between 11.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m. and to co-operate with the investigation.

6. List the application on 9/2/2023, high on board.
7.
Till then, no coercive steps be taken against the applicant.

(M. S. KARNIK, J.)
